content: Yoyɑkimun wɑɑti sɔɔrɑ Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko u Yudɑbɑ wɔri u bu tɑɑrewɑ wɔ̃ɔ itɑ. Yen biru bɑ nùn seesi bu kɑ tii yinɑ.
Adɑmɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ Bɑbilonin tɑbu kowobu kɑ Siriɡibu, kɑ Mɔɑbubɑ, kɑ Amɔniɡibu, bɑ Yoyɑkimu wɔri bu kɑ Yudɑbɑ kpeerɑsiɑ nɡe mɛ u ɡeruɑ sɑɑ win sɔmɔbun nɔɔn di.
U yeni kuɑwɑ u kɑ Yudɑbɑ ɡirɑ win wuswɑɑn di Mɑnɑsen torɑ ni u kuɑn sɔ̃.
Domi Mɑnɑse wi, u tɑɑrɛ sɑriruɡibun yɛm yɑri mu kokɑ Yerusɑlɛmun swɛɛ sɔɔ. Yeni kpuron sɔ̃nɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u ǹ bu suuru kue.
Ye Yoyɑkimu u kuɑn sukum ye kpuron ɡɑri yi yoruɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑmbun fɑɑɡin tireru sɔɔ.
Yenibɑn biru u kpunɑ u ɡu. Mɑ bɑ nùn sikɑ win bɑɑbɑbɑn sikɑɔ. Mɑ win bii Yoyɑkini u bɑndu kɔsire kuɑ.
Eɡibitin tɑbu kowobu bɑ ǹ mɑɑ yɑrire ben tem di. Domi Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko u bu tem mwɑɑri sɑɑ Eɡibitin dɑɑrun di sere n kɑ ɡirɑri dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Efɑrɑtiɔ.
Yoyɑkini
u kuɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko
Wɔ̃ɔ yɛndu yiru sɑriwɑ Yoyɑkini u mɔ sɑɑ ye u bɑndu di. Win mɛron yĩsirɑ Nɛhusitɑ Ɛlinɑtɑni Yerusɑlɛmuɡiin bii.
Yoyɑkini wi, u ǹ kue dee dee Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ. Kɔ̃sɑ u kuɑ mɑm mɑm nɡe mɛ win tundo u rɑɑ kuɑ.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑn tɑbu kowobu bɑ nɑ bɑ Yerusɑlɛmu wɔri bɑ ye tɑrusi.
Mɑ wi sinɑ bokon tii u nɑ mi, u bu deemɑ.

Yerɑ Yoyɑkini Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko u yɑrɑ u Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ wi sennɔ dɑ kɑ win mɛro, kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu kɑ win sinɑ ɑsɑkpɔbu kɑ win yɛnun sɔm kowobun wiruɡibu. Mɑ Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ u nùn mwɑ u pirisɔm doke. U yeni kuɑwɑ win bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ itɑse sɔɔ.
Mɑ u sɑ̃ɑ yerun ɑrumɑni ɡurɑ, mɑ u ten dendi yɑ̃ɑ ni Sɑlomɔɔ u kuɑ kɑ wurɑ kɔsukɑ, mɑ u mɑɑ sinɑ kpɑɑrun ɑrumɑni ɡurɑ nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ.
Mɑ u Yerusɑlɛmun wiruɡibu kɑ ben dɑmɡibu ɡurɑ u kɑ dɑ ben mi. Ben ɡeerɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ wɔkuru (10.000). Ben ɡɑbɑ sɑ̃ɑ sekobu ɡɑbu mɑɑ dɑ̃ɑ dɑ̃kobu. Bwɛ̃ɛbwɛ̃ɛbu tɔnɑwɑ u deri.
U sinɑ boko Yoyɑkini kɑ win mɛro kɑ win kurɔbu kɑ win yɛnun sɔm kowobun wiruɡibu kɑ tem min dɑmɡibu kpuro ɡurɑ u kɑ dɑ Bɑbiloniɔ.
Tɑbu kowo be u ɡurɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ nɔɔbɑ yiru (7.000). Mɑ nɔmɑn sɔm kowobu bɑ sɑ̃ɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbu (1.000). Be kpuro bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɑbu durɔ wɔruɡɔbɑ.
Yen biru u Mɑtɑniɑ kuɑ sunɔ Yoyɑkinin ɑyerɔ. Mɑ u nùn yĩsiru kɑ̃ Sedesiɑsi. Mɑtɑniɑ wi, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ Yoyɑkinin tundon wɔnɔ.
Sedesiɑsi
u kuɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko
Sɑɑ ye Sedesiɑsi u bɑndu di Yerusɑlɛmuɔ, u mɔwɑ wɔ̃ɔ yɛndɑ tiɑ. Mɑ u kuɑ wɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ tiɑ bɑndu sɔɔ. Win mɛron yĩsirɑ Hɑmutɑli Yeremi Libinɑɡiin bii.
Sedesiɑsi wi, u ǹ kue dee dee Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ. Kɔ̃sɑ ye Yoyɑkimu u rɑɑ kuɑ, yerɑ win tii u mɑɑ kuɑ mɑm mɑm.

Ye kpuro yɑ koorɑ yèn sɔ̃ Yinni Gusunɔ u kɑ Yudɑbɑ kɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɡibu mɔru kuɑ domi u kĩ u bu fɛ̃rɑ u kɔ̃. Bɑ Yerusɑlɛmu tɑrusi (I mɑɑ mɛɛrio Yeremi 39:1-7; 52:3-11) Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ Sedesiɑsi u Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko seesi.
